rationale: For a digital subscription marketplace, trust, clarity, and authority are paramount. A Swiss & High-Contrast approach ensures buyers can easily compare offers and sellers can efficiently manage demands. It avoids the 'crypto-bro' dark mode and establishes a professional, transparent environment.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4. H1 max text-5xl.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense content. Never center by default.

components.navigation: Crystal Glass style. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-black/5. Must be z-50 sticky.
components.cards_dashboard: Neumorphism hybrid. bg-white, 1px border-black/5, shadow-sm. Hover: -translate-y-1 shadow-lg.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or max rounded-md. Primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white. Hover: bg-[#002280].
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults but customized with border-black/10, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7] focus:border-transparent.
components.badges: For trust/verification: bg-green-100 text-green-800 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wide.

accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY for all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='post-demand-button').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs and buttons.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue and white 3D shapes. Use as a subtle, masked background in the marketing hero section.
Professional smiling man using laptop. Use for verified seller profile placeholders.
Close-up of smartphone icons. Use as a conceptual image for the digital subscription catalog.

icons.usage: Use for UI elements. Ensure consistent stroke-width (usually 1.5 or 2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype strictly. Do not introduce unnecessary dark mode interfaces or neon colors.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Implement Shadcn UI for forms, tables, and dialogs, but customize the styling to remove the default 'Vercel' look (e.g., use sharper corners, specific borders).
For the Buyer/Seller dashboards, use the 'Control Room' grid pattern: tight gaps (gap-6), single-metric focus cards on the top row.
Every interactive element MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
Do not use generic 'dummyimage' placeholders. Use the provided image URLs in the media section.
Ensure the hero section uses the provided abstract 3D image with a proper white/gray gradient overlay so text remains readable.
Ensure code is generated for .jsx/.js files instead of .tsx files since the project uses JavaScript.
